The search-records agent completed the search. Here is its full report:

---

**Searches run:**
- **log_001:** Place-anchored children search (Sankt Georgen, 1808–1830), 20 hits, positive.
- **log_002:** Place-free children search (Germany, no collection pin), the same 20 hits, no new children, positive.

---

**Children found** — all naming Johann Georg Meyer/Mayer and Maria Dorothea (Stockburger variants) as parents:

| # | Name | Born | Notes |
|---|------|------|-------|
| 1 | Christina | 22 Oct 1809 | Christened Sankt Georgen |
| 2 | Jacob | 8 Dec 1810 | Christened Sankt Georgen (Oberkirnach baptism also indexed) |
| 3 | Andreas | 5 Sep 1812 | Christened Sankt Georgen; d. 1852 |
| 4 | Dorothea | 18 Jan 1814 | Christened Sankt Georgen |
| 5 | Johann Georg | 27 Apr 1815 | Christened 28 Apr 1815; buried 6 May 1817 (d. 4 May 1817) |
| 6 | **Magdalena** | **5 Mar 1817** | **Already in tree** |
| 7 | Joseph | 13 Aug 1818 | Baptised 15–16 Aug 1818 |
| 8 | Johannes | 8 Mar 1820 | Christened 10 Mar 1820, Sankt Georgen |
| 9 | **Anna Maria** | **9 Nov 1821** | **Already in tree** |
| 10 | Salome | 25 Oct 1824 | Christened 27 Oct 1824; buried 25 Mar 1827 (d. 22 Mar 1827) |
| 11 | Joh. Georg | 13 Apr 1826 | Christened 16 Apr 1826 |

---

**Summary:** Eleven children were found born between 1809 and 1826. Two (Magdalena and Anna Maria) are already in the tree. Nine children are new: Christina, Jacob, Andreas, Dorothea, Johann Georg (d. young), Joseph, Johannes, Salome (d. young), and a second Johann Georg. The Meyer/Mayer surname spelling varies across records. Some children appear in both the Sankt Georgen and Oberkirnach collections under the same dates. These are index entries only — original parish registers have not yet been examined.

**Next step:** The nine new children can be extracted and added to the tree once you confirm you want that done.
